related_questions.question: Is it hard to get into investor relations?
related_questions.snippet: Investor Relations is not really that difficult to get into since it doesn't require any specialized finance skills. The role is primarily communications. If you do ER prior to jumping to IR, you can usually get in at the Manager level. If you do FLDP -> IR, you start at the Sr. Analyst level.
